definitions.explanation: A period of six months; half of one year.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}に{来|き}て{半年|はんとし}になる。
examples.english: It's been half a year since I came to Japan.

examples.japanese: {半年|はんとし}ぶりに{友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I met my friend for the first time in half a year.

examples.japanese: あと{半年|はんとし}で{卒業|そつぎょう}だ。
examples.english: I'll graduate in another six months.

notes:
COMPOUND: {半|はん} (half) + {年|とし} (year)

ALTERNATE READING: {半年|はんねん} is also used in some contexts (more formal).

TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- {半日|はんにち} (half a day)
- {半月|はんつき} (half a month)
- {半年|はんとし} (half a year)
- {一年半|いちねんはん} (one and a half years)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {半年|はんとし}で (in half a year)
- {半年|はんとし}ぶりに (for the first time in half a year)
- {半年|はんとし}ごとに (every half year)
- {半年|はんとし}{後|ご} (half a year later)
